name: @guardbee/mcp-db-gateway
description: KVKK/GDPR-compliant MCP gateway between LLMs and databases. PII masking, RBAC, rate limiting, audit logging.
long_description: GuardBee MCP DB Gateway sits between your LLM and database, automatically masking PII fields (TC kimlik, IBAN, email, phone), enforcing role-based table access, rate limiting queries, and writing audit logs. Supports Prisma and any database via custom adapters.

databaseUrl.title: Database URL
databaseUrl.description: Database connection string (e.g. postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/db). Leave empty to run in demo mode.

gatewayRole.title: Active Role
gatewayRole.description: RBAC role name (optional). Must match a role defined in your config.
